disposition: Additive VP-08 only. VP-01…VP-07.1 registers unchanged.

codes.reference_rule: VP-08 §2 rows 1–2, SS-1…SS-5: wrong format/profile, unknown keys, hard limits, unknown anchor or form, duplicate IDs
VP-08 §2 row 3: message names an undeclared participant; self with from ≠ to; non-self with from = to
VP-08 §2 row 4, ST-1, D-3: trigger kind outside the closed set, enters not a participant, unknown trigger
VP-08 §2 row 5, SF-1…SF-3, D-5: alt < 2 operands, opt/loop ≠ 1, empty operand, missing guard/bound, depth > 2
VP-08 §2 row 6, SS-6, D-6, D-7: over budget with reject or detail; fragment depth over budget; one top-level item over budget
VP-08 §2 row 7, D-7: rendered as message windows with continuation markers; never a verdict
VP-08 §2 row 8, D-4: declared return without an open declared call on the pair; never a verdict
VP-08 §2 row 9, D-4: call without declared return where the trigger declares returns: expected; never a verdict
VP-08 §2 row 10: method_id not in the supplied method_contracts list; display check only, never P1 validation
VP-08 §2 row 11, ST-3: files, digests, inputs, units or coverage differ from a deterministic re-render; unknown partition
VP-08 §2 row 12: active SVG content, embedded ledger mismatch, drawn messages differ, message partition not exact
VP-08 VP-07 rule: unreadable, oversized, duplicate-key or non-finite JSON
VP-08 VP-06 PE-5 rule: output already exists
VP-08 VP-06 PE-5 rule: staging or publish failed
